name: com.globalfinreg/lei
title: Global FinReg
description: LEI lookup, entity maps and company filings; register, renew and transfer LEIs with Global FinReg.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Returns Global FinReg's LEI prices in every supported currency, excluding VAT: for a new registration and for a renewal, for 1, 3 and 5 years, each as pricePerYear and total for the whole period; and the optional fully assisted service. For the exact total for one LEI, including VAT, use get_registration_quote or get_renewal_quote.

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Creates a Global FinReg account for a user from their email address, so they can order and manage LEIs. GFR emails the address a link to set a password; you get no access to the account from this tool. After the user has set a password, register for access with /auth.md and use the account tools. If the address already has an account nothing changes, and the answer is the same. Ask the user for their email address, first name and last name, and confirm them with them before calling.

email.description: The user's email address. The account and all GFR emails use it.

firstName.description: The user's first name, as the user gave it. Required.

lastName.description: The user's last name, as the user gave it. Required.

languageCode.description: Language code for the account, e.g. en, da, nn (Norwegian), sv, de, fr. The welcome email is in en, da, nn or sv, otherwise English. Default en.

currencyCode.description: Currency for prices and invoices, e.g. EUR, DKK, SEK, NOK, USD, GBP. Default EUR.

tools.name: search_lei_by_company_name
tools.description: Searches the global LEI register by legal entity name. Returns matching entities with their LEI, country and a link to the entity's GlobalFinReg lookup page.

query.description: The legal name (or part of it) of the entity, at least 3 characters.

tools.name: get_lei_record
tools.description: Returns the registration record of an LEI from the global LEI register: legal name, legal and headquarters address, jurisdiction, legal form, entity and registration status, registration and renewal dates and the managing LOU.

tools.name: get_ui_labels
tools.description: For the Global FinReg views only, not for the assistant: returns the views' labels in a language and what the views may offer on this endpoint. It returns no data about the user.

language.description: The language as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. da or pt-BR. Default: the language of the user's account, or English.

tools.name: lookup_legal_form
tools.description: Looks up an entity legal form (ISO 20275 ELF code list) in a country: by ELF code first, otherwise by the legal form's local name, optionally within a region of the country.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DK.

localName.description: The legal form's local name, e.g. Anpartsselskab.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-2 region code, for countries whose legal forms differ by region.
